checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Initial square image shows robot at a recognisable train station
must.why: Platform, trains, canopy and yellow line are clear.

must.item: Round teal body, exactly one large amber eye, short red boots, yellow mailbag in all three
must.why: Robot has two amber eyes in image 1 and 3 (and two in image 2). Violates the one-eye requirement.
Same teal body, ear pods, red boots, yellow bag, though the bag/body proportions vary slightly.

must.item: One follow-up parcel at cottage door; other sheltering under giant mushroom with rain
must.why: Image 2 shows a parcel at a cottage door. Image 3 shows a giant mushroom with rain.

must.item: Three square pictures, consistent storybook style, no text
must.why: Style is consistent and square. Image 1 has small sign-like marks at the left pillar, with no legible text.

faults.what: Robot has two eyes in all three images instead of the single large amber eye the user asked for.
Small sign-like marks on the station pillar and wall in image 1 look like faint pseudo-text.
Image 2: the robot's pose is slightly awkward, with the bag worn like a backpack. In image 1 the bag sits on the side.

summary: The three storybook scenes are charming, consistent and well matched to the prompts, but the robot has two amber eyes in every image instead of the one large eye the user specified.
